e.title: **一个**很薄的镜像：**它的启动命令**直接调用**包自己的 `run_app()`****：Docker Hub 镜像 `vitorcapdeville/mortalitytablemaker`——**⭐ 逐字自述**「**Shiny app with some techniques for modelling mortality tables**」**；**⭐ 启动命令逐字为** `/bin/sh -c R -e "options(’shiny.port’=80,shiny.host=’0.0.0.0’);mortalitytablemaker::run_app()"`**；**⭐ 而**构建时**从本地源码安装**并**把**构建目录**删掉****（**逐字** `remotes::install_local(upgrade="never")` 与 **`rm -rf /build_zone`**）**；**⚠️ 而**它**只发一个 `latest` 标签**、**端口是 **80**、**共 **41 层****
e.title_en: A very thin image whose start command calls the package own application runner: the description names a Shiny application with techniques for modelling mortality tables, the command invokes the package run-app function directly, the build installs from local source with upgrades disabled and then deletes the build zone, and only a single latest tag is published with the application served on port eighty.
e.title_hk: **一個**很薄的鏡像：**它的啟動命令**直接調用**包自己的 `run_app()`****：Docker Hub 鏡像 `vitorcapdeville/mortalitytablemaker`——**⭐ 逐字自述**「**Shiny app with some techniques for modelling mortality tables**」**；**⭐ 啟動命令逐字為** `/bin/sh -c R -e "options(’shiny.port’=80,shiny.host=’0.0.0.0’);mortalitytablemaker::run_app()"`**；**⭐ 而**構建時**從本地源碼安裝**並**把構建目錄刪掉****；**⚠️ 而**它只發一個 `latest` 標籤**、**端口是 80**、**共 41 層****
e.summary: **vitorcapdeville/mortalitytablemaker**（Docker Hub 镜像）**是一个**把 **R 包 **`mortalitytablemaker`** 的 **Shiny 应用**包起来的**容器镜像****——**逐字自述为**「**Shiny app with some techniques for modelling mortality tables**」**。**本次实测**：**累计拉取 **305 次****、**★0**、**创建 **2021-09-12**、**最后更新 **2021-09-12****、**⭐ 只有一个 **`latest` 标签**（**571 MB**）**、**架构 **`amd64/linux`****。**⭐⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**容器登记处：模型被打成一个可运行的镜像**」**。**⭐⭐⭐ 四处最值得看**：**① **⭐ 启动命令**逐字为** `/bin/sh -c R -e "options(’shiny.port’=80,shiny.host=’0.0.0.0’);mortalitytablemaker::run_app()"`**——**⭐ 即**镜像**几乎不含**业务逻辑**，**它**只是**把**那个包**装好**、**再**调用**包自带**的运行入口**；**② **构建时**从**本地源码**安装**并**逐字带 **`upgrade="never"`**（**⭐ 即**不升级**已有依赖**，**以求**可复现**）**，**随后**逐字** `rm -rf /build_zone`**（**把**构建目录**删掉**）**；**③ **它**把应用**放在**端口 **80****（**⭐ 而**本轮另一条同类镜像**用的是 **3838**）**——**⭐ 即**同一个技术栈**的两种**部署约定**；**④ **⚠️ 而**标签里的**作者与**基础镜像**仍**指向 **Rocker 项目**（**逐字** `org.opencontainers.image.base.name` 为 **`docker.io/library/ubuntu:focal`**、**描述为**「**Reproducible builds to fixed version of R**」**）**。**⚠️ 本次**未拉取、**未运行**。
e.summary_hk: **vitorcapdeville/mortalitytablemaker**（Docker Hub 鏡像）**是一個**把 **R 包 `mortalitytablemaker` 的 Shiny 應用**包起來的**容器鏡像****——**逐字自述為**「**Shiny app with some techniques for modelling mortality tables**」**。**本次實測**：**累計拉取 305 次****、**★0**、**創建 2021-09-12**、**最後更新 2021-09-12****、**⭐ 只有一個 `latest` 標籤（**571 MB**）**、**架構 `amd64/linux`****。**⭐⭐ 本條目屬於本輪主題**「**容器登記處：模型被打成一個可運行的鏡像**」**。**⭐⭐⭐ 四處最值得看**：**① **⭐ 啟動命令逐字為** `/bin/sh -c R -e "options(’shiny.port’=80,shiny.host=’0.0.0.0’);mortalitytablemaker::run_app()"`**——**⭐ 即**鏡像**幾乎不含業務邏輯**，**只是把那個包裝好、**再調用包自帶的運行入口**；**② **構建時從本地源碼安裝**並逐字帶 `upgrade="never"`**（**不升級已有依賴以求可複現**）**，**隨後逐字 `rm -rf /build_zone`****；**③ **它把應用放在端口 80**（**而本輪另一條同類鏡像用的是 3838**）**——**⭐ 即**同一技術棧的兩種部署約定**；**④ **⚠️ 而**標籤裡的作者與基礎鏡像**仍指向 **Rocker 專案****。**⚠️ 本次**未拉取、**未運行**。
e.summary_en: This Docker Hub image **wraps the Shiny application of an R package for modelling mortality tables**, described verbatim as a Shiny app with some techniques for modelling mortality tables. **Measured this round**: three hundred and five pulls, no stars, created and last updated on the same day in September 2021, a single latest tag of about five hundred and seventy megabytes, and support for amd64 only. **This entry belongs to the round theme of the container registry, where a model is packaged as something that can actually be run.** **Four things are worth reading: the start command invokes the package own run-app function directly, so the image carries almost no business logic and is essentially the package plus a launcher; the build installs from local source with dependency upgrades disabled and then deletes the build directory; the application is served on port eighty, whereas another comparable image in this round uses a different port, showing two deployment conventions for the same technology; and the author and base image labels still point at the base image project, whose description promises reproducible builds against a fixed R version.** **The image was not pulled or run this round.**
e.body:
**vitorcapdeville/mortalitytablemaker**（Docker Hub 镜像）**是一个**把 **R 包 **`mortalitytablemaker`** 的 **Shiny 应用**包起来的**容器镜像****——**逐字自述为**「**Shiny app with some techniques for modelling mortality tables**」**。**⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**容器登记处：模型被打成一个可运行的镜像**」**。**引号约定（本条）**：**所引 **R 启动命令**里的**单引号**原文为 **ASCII 撇号**，**本站按既有约定一律写作弯撇号 **U+2019****（**⭐ 故**本条中的命令**与**原始 `Cmd` **在**引号字符上**并不逐字节相同**）**。

**可核实信息（均 Docker Hub 登记接口与镜像配置实测）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 启动命令直接调用**包自带的运行入口，**故镜像很薄****——**⭐ 本次实测**其 `Cmd` 逐字为** `/bin/sh -c R -e "options(’shiny.port’=80,shiny.host=’0.0.0.0’);mortalitytablemaker::run_app()"`**；**⭐ 本词条认为**这一行**把一件事说清楚了**：**⭐ 即**这个镜像**几乎不含业务逻辑**——**它**只做**三件事**：**装好那个包**、**设好监听端口与地址**、**再**调用**包自己的 **`run_app()`****；**⭐ 对 RIAA**：**这是**「**把已有成果打包**」**最省力的一种做法**，**而**它**也**意味着**：**镜像的能力**完全**取决于**那个包**——**⭐ 故**读者**应当**去读**包的说明**，**而**不是**读镜像**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 构建时从本地源码安装、**逐字禁用依赖升级**，**然后**删掉构建目录****——**⭐ 本次实测**其构建历史逐字含**：**「**RUN /bin/sh -c R -e remotes::install_local(upgrade="never")**」**（**⭐ 即**从**本地源码**安装**，**且**不升级**已有依赖**）**、**「**RUN /bin/sh -c rm -rf /build_zone **」**、**「**EXPOSE map[80/tcp:{}]**」**；**⭐ 共 **41 层****。**⭐ 本词条认为**这一组**值得记**：**⭐ 即**「**不升级已有依赖**」**是**一条**明确的**可复现性取舍**——**⭐ 它**用**「**可能装到旧版本**」**换**「**今天的构建**与**当时的构建一致**」**；**⭐ 而**构建完**把**构建目录**删掉**，**是**为了**减小镜像**，**也**意味着**镜像里**看不到**构建中间产物**。**⭐⭐ ③ 同一技术栈的两种部署约定**——**⭐ 本镜像**把应用**放在端口 **80****（**`shiny.host` 逐字为 **`0.0.0.0`**）**，**而**本轮另一条 **Shiny 镜像**（**`actuarial/shiny-chainladder`）**用的是 **3838****。**⭐ 本词条认为**这一对照**值得记**：**⭐ 即**同一个技术栈**在**两个团队手里**会有**两套默认端口**——**⭐ 故**使用者**必须**读**配置**，**不能**凭**技术栈**猜端口**。**⭐⭐ ④ ⚠️ 标签里的作者与基础镜像**仍指向 **Rocker 项目****——**⭐ 本次实测**其标签逐字含**「**org.opencontainers.image.authors**」为**一位 **Rocker 维护者姓名**（**⭐ 其值含邮箱**，**本词条不复制**）**、「**org.opencontainers.image.base.name**」为 **`docker.io/library/ubuntu:focal`**、「**org.opencontainers.image.description**」为**「**Reproducible builds to fixed version of R**」**、「**org.opencontainers.image.licenses**」为 **`GPL-2.0-or-later`****。**⭐ 本词条**如实指出**：**这是**本轮**第三条**出现**同一形态**（**镜像标签描述**的是**基础镜像**，**而**不是**本镜像**）**——**⭐ 故**读者**不能**据此**判断**本镜像的**作者或**许可**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[mortalitytables]]、**[[mortalitylaws]]、**[[cmi-mortality-projections]]、**[[mortalityforecast]] 覆盖**死亡率表与**预测方法**——**⭐ 而**本条补上的是**「**把一个**死亡率表建模的 **Shiny 应用**用**最薄的方式**打成镜像**（**启动即调用包自带入口**）**」这一形态**；**⭐ 本词条**不对以上任何一条做代码级比较****。

**对 RIAA**：**⭐ 本条最值得借的四件事**：**① **打包时**要**分清**「**镜像提供了什么**」与**「**包提供了什么**」**；**② **可复现性**要**明确取舍**（**如**禁用依赖升级**）**；**③ **端口与主机绑定**要**写在能被看到的地方**；**④ **镜像标签**要**看清**归属**。

**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**没有拉取、**没有运行**该镜像**（**未启动容器、**未打开任何界面、**未做任何死亡率建模**）**，**故**不主张**其**可运行**、**不主张**其中**方法的**正确性**。**② ⚠️ 本次**只读**登记接口、**标签列表与**镜像配置**（**含**构建历史与**标签字段**）**，**未读**该 R 包的**源码或**文档**。**③ ⚠️ 未核实**镜像内**那个 R 包的**版本号**（**⭐ 只知**构建发生在 **2021-09-12**）**。**④ ⚠️ **未核实**其**放在端口 **80** 是否**需要**特权**（**⭐ 本词条**不给出**部署建议**）**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核实**其**数据来源**（**⭐ 说明**未提**数据**）**。**⑥ ⚠️ 未核实**发布者身份**（**⭐ 只知**命名空间名**）。**⑦ ⚠️ **窗口状况**：**创建与**最后更新**同为 **2021-09-12**（**远在**解冻窗口之外**）**——**本次按惯例把这一处写在这里**：**本条的缺口是**「**把死亡率表建模的 Shiny 应用**用**最薄的方式**打成容器镜像**」这一形态**。**⑧ ⚠️ 本条目所记为 2026-09-11 所见**；**⚠️ 并如实提示**：**该镜像**是**个人发布**，**不是**任何**官方或**精算意见**，**其**建模结果**须**由使用者**独立复核**。

e.body_hk:
**vitorcapdeville/mortalitytablemaker**（Docker Hub 鏡像）**是一個**把 **R 包 `mortalitytablemaker` 的 Shiny 應用**包起來的**容器鏡像****——**逐字自述為**「**Shiny app with some techniques for modelling mortality tables**」**。**⭐ 本條目屬於本輪主題**「**容器登記處：模型被打成一個可運行的鏡像**」**。**引號約定（本條）**：**所引 R 啟動命令裡的單引號**原文為 **ASCII 撇號**，**本站一律寫作 U+2019****（**⭐ 故**本條中的命令**與**原始 `Cmd`** 在**引號字元上**並不逐位元組相同**）**。

**可核實資訊（均 Docker Hub 登記介面與鏡像配置實測）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 啟動命令直接調用包自帶的運行入口，**故鏡像很薄****——**其 `Cmd` 逐字為** `/bin/sh -c R -e "options(’shiny.port’=80,shiny.host=’0.0.0.0’);mortalitytablemaker::run_app()"`**；**⭐ 即**這個鏡像**幾乎不含業務邏輯**——**只做三件事**：**裝好那個包**、**設好監聽端口與地址**、**再調用包自己的 `run_app()`****；**⭐ 對 RIAA**：**這是「**把已有成果打包**」最省力的做法**，**也意味著**：**鏡像的能力完全取決於那個包**——**⭐ 故**讀者應去讀包的說明**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 構建時從本地源碼安裝、**逐字禁用依賴升級**，**然後刪掉構建目錄****——**構建歷史逐字含 RUN /bin/sh -c R -e remotes::install_local(upgrade="never")**、**RUN /bin/sh -c rm -rf /build_zone**、**EXPOSE map[80/tcp:{}]**；**共 41 層****。**⭐ 「**不升級已有依賴**」**是一條明確的可複現性取捨**：**⭐ 用「**可能裝到舊版本**」**換「**今天的構建與當時一致**」**。**⭐⭐ ③ 同一技術棧的兩種部署約定**——**本鏡像放在端口 80**（**`shiny.host` 逐字為 `0.0.0.0`**）**，**而本輪另一條 Shiny 鏡像用的是 3838****——**⭐ 故**使用者必須讀配置**，**不能憑技術棧猜端口**。**⭐⭐ ④ ⚠️ 標籤裡的作者與基礎鏡像仍指向 Rocker 專案****——**逐字含 org.opencontainers.image.authors 為一位 Rocker 維護者姓名**（**其值含郵箱**，**不複製**）**、org.opencontainers.image.base.name 為 `docker.io/library/ubuntu:focal`**、**org.opencontainers.image.description 為 Reproducible builds to fixed version of R**、**org.opencontainers.image.licenses 為 `GPL-2.0-or-later`****。**⭐ 本輪第三條出現同一形態**：**標籤描述的是基礎鏡像**，**不是本鏡像**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 與池內條目的關係**：[[mortalitytables]]、[[mortalitylaws]]、[[cmi-mortality-projections]]、[[mortalityforecast]]——**⭐ 本條補上的是**「**把死亡率表建模的 Shiny 應用用最薄的方式打成鏡像**」這一形態**；**⭐ 本詞條**不對以上任何一條做代碼級比較****。

**對 RIAA**：**⭐ 四件事值得借**：**① **分清鏡像提供了什麼與包提供了什麼**；**② **可複現性要明確取捨**；**③ **端口與主機綁定要寫在看得見的地方**；**④ **看清鏡像標籤的歸屬**。

**⚠️ 本詞條如實標註**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**沒有拉取、**沒有運行**該鏡像**，**不主張**其可運行或其中方法的正確性**。**② ⚠️ 本次**只讀登記介面、**標籤列表與鏡像配置**，**未讀**該 R 包的源碼或文檔**。**③ ⚠️ 未核實**鏡像內那個 R 包的版本號**（**只知**構建發生在 2021-09-12**）**。**④ ⚠️ 未核實**其放在端口 80 是否需要特權**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核實**其數據來源**（**說明未提數據**）**。**⑥ ⚠️ 未核實**發布者身份**。**⑦ ⚠️ **窗口狀況**：**創建與最後更新同為 2021-09-12（**遠在窗口之外**）**——**本條的缺口是**「**把死亡率表建模的 Shiny 應用用最薄的方式打成容器鏡像**」這一形態**。**⑧ ⚠️ 本條目所記為 2026-09-11 所見**；**⚠️ 該鏡像是個人發布**，**其建模結果須由使用者獨立覆核**。

e.body_en:
This Docker Hub image **wraps the Shiny application of an R package for modelling mortality tables**, described verbatim as a Shiny app with some techniques for modelling mortality tables. **This entry belongs to the round theme of the container registry, where a model is packaged as something that can actually be run.**

**Verified information, all measured from the registry interfaces and the image configuration**: **first, the start command calls the package own run-app function, which makes the image thin.** The configured command sets a listening port and host and then invokes the package run-app entry point directly, **so the image carries almost no business logic: it installs the package, sets the port and host, and calls the launcher the package already ships. That is the least effortful way to package an existing result, and it also means the image capability is entirely the package capability, so a reader should read the package documentation rather than the image.** **Second, the build installs from local source with dependency upgrades explicitly disabled and then deletes the build directory.** The build history shows a local install with the upgrade flag set to never, followed by removal of the build zone and the exposure of a single port, across forty-one layers. **Disabling upgrades is a deliberate reproducibility trade-off: it accepts that older versions may be installed in exchange for today build matching the build of that time, and deleting the build directory afterwards shrinks the image while also removing the intermediate build artefacts from view.** **Third, two deployment conventions exist for the same technology**: this image serves the application on port eighty, while another Shiny image in this round uses a different port. **A reader therefore has to read the configuration rather than guessing the port from the technology stack.** **Fourth, the author and base image labels still point at the base project**, naming one of its maintainers, with an address this entry does not reproduce, recording the base as a minimal Ubuntu image and describing the base as reproducible builds against a fixed R version, under a copyleft licence. **This is the third image in this round with the same shape, where the labels describe the base rather than this artefact, so a reader cannot infer the author or licence of this image from them.** **Fifth, relative to existing entries**: pooled entries cover mortality tables, mortality laws, projection methods and forecasting, **while this entry supplies the thinnest possible packaging of a mortality table modelling application as a container image whose start command defers entirely to the package. This entry makes no code-level comparison against any of them.**

**For RIAA**: **four practices transfer: distinguish what the image provides from what the package provides; state reproducibility trade-offs explicitly, as this build does by disabling upgrades; put the port and host binding where it can be seen; and read image labels knowing their provenance.**

**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, the image was neither pulled nor run**, so no container was started, no interface was opened and no mortality modelling was performed, **and no claim is made that it runs or that the methods inside it are correct**. **Second, only the registry interface, the tag list and the image configuration were read**, including the build history and label fields, **and neither the source nor the documentation of the R package was read**. **Third, the version of the package inside the image was not verified**, only that the build took place on a specific day in September 2021. **Fourth, whether serving on port eighty requires privileges was not verified, and this entry offers no deployment advice.** **Fifth, the source of its data was not verified**, the description mentioning no data. **Sixth, the publisher identity was not verified** beyond the namespace name. **Seventh, on the window: it was created and last updated on the same day in September 2021, far outside the thaw window**, and following the project convention of naming the gap, **the gap is the thinnest possible packaging of a mortality table modelling application as a container image. Eighth, this entry records what was visible on 2026-09-11 and states plainly that the image is an individual publication rather than any official or actuarial opinion, and that its modelling results must be independently reviewed by the user.** **Note on quotation: the single quotes inside the quoted R start command are ASCII apostrophes in the original, and this project follows its existing convention of writing them as a typographic apostrophe, so the command shown here is not byte-identical to the original configuration in that respect.**
